intervention_names: Device: FEMH Electronic Glucose Management System (FEMH-eGMS)
arm_groups.label: FEMH Electronic Glucose Management System (FEMH-eGMS)

brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to compare the eGMS designed by FEMH with the usual insulin ordering protocol in the safety and efficacy of subcutaneous insulin therapy in ordinary ward.
brief_title: Effectiveness and Safety of an Electronic Medical Record-Integrated Glucose Management System for Inpatient Diabetes Care: A Randomized Controlled Trial

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age ≥ 20 years
* Type 2 diabetes mellitus
* Required four-times-daily subcutaneous basal-bolus insulin during admission
* At least two point-of-care glucose readings \>180 mg/dL during admission

Exclusion Criteria:

* Type 1 diabetes mellitus
* Pregnancy
* Gestational diabetes
* Hyperosmolar hyperglycemic state or diabetic ketoacidosis at admission
* Total parenteral nutrition
* Treatment with intravenous insulin infusion (insulin pump)

official_title: Comparison of the Safety and Efficacy of the Far Eastern Memorial Hospital Electronic Glucose Management System (eGMS) With Conventional Subcutaneous Basal-Bolus Insulin Protocol in Ordinary Ward Patients: A Prospective Randomized Controlled Trial

primary_outcomes.measure: the mean percent of glucose readings between 140 and 180 mg/dL per patient
primary_outcomes.time_frame: through study completion, an average of 7 days
